title: Apache Security Advisories - 2026-10-28
description:
Merged 12 apache security advisories published on 2026-10-28. Original advisory IDs: CVE-2026-114349, CVE-2026-112375, CVE-2026-111551, CVE-2026-111115, CVE-2026-111108, CVE-2026-110985, CVE-2026-116593, CVE-2026-111073, CVE-2026-110952, CVE-2026-115644, CVE-2026-111496, CVE-2026-83525

Titles:
- Apache Kafka: Apache Kafka: Denial of service via unbounded memory allocation when decoding compressed record batches
- Apache Kafka: Apache Kafka: Unauthorized principal can read arbitrary broker files via IncrementalAlterConfigs
- Apache Kafka: Apache Kafka: Denial of service in Kafka Streams and client deserializers via unbounded memory allocation
- Apache Kafka: Apache Kafka: Broker OutOfMemoryError via tagged-field allocation amplification in flexible protocol request parsing
- Apache Kafka: Apache Kafka: Broker OutOfMemoryError via array allocation amplification in code-generated protocol readers
- Apache Kafka: Apache Kafka: Broker silently skips JWT signature verification for SASL/OAUTHBEARER when the JWKS endpoint URL is not configured
- Apache Kafka: Apache Kafka: Kafka Connect configuration provider values exposed via validation REST API endpoint
- Apache Kafka: Apache Kafka: PushTelemetry (KIP-714) metrics payloads are decompressed without a size limit, allowing a broker out-of-memory denial of service
- Apache Kafka: Apache Kafka: Broker does not enforce JWT issuer and audience validation for SASL/OAUTHBEARER by default
- Apache Kafka: Apache Kafka: Connect Admin REST API Authentication Bypass via Unapplied REST Extensions
- Apache Kafka: Apache Kafka: Kafka Streams StreamThread hang from integer overflow in stream-time punctuation
- Apache Kafka: Apache Kafka: Incorrect boolean operator in FetchSnapshot RPC handler allows authenticated network clients to crash the KRaft controller via a malformed request
